name: Spindlewight
description: The beasties' leader who rescued two children, then renounced leadership after a keep-alive saw his maskless face.

description_citations.text: "Beast". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight, the pack's first leader, leaves to find the beasties' purpose.
timeline.quote: he left us, left his pack and his kin, to walk the body of House

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight fashions a mask of bone and scrap to protect his eyes.
timeline.quote: To protect his eyes, he fashioned himself a mask of broken bone and stolen scrap.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: In a ruined library Spindlewight hears crying for the first time.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight finds one adult and two small children clinging together in the wreckage.
timeline.quote: there he found three creatures, one large and two much smaller, clinging to each other in the wreckage.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A cellarspawn attacks the family and Spindlewight drives it away and fells it.
timeline.quote: Spindlewight attacked it, driving it away from his discovery

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The adult is found pinned by a spike of wood loosened in the fight and is dying.
timeline.quote: a spike of jagged wood protruding from its middle

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The dying adult asks Spindlewight to keep the children alive.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight accepts the children as keep-alives and vows to protect them.
timeline.quote: He would keep them alive, as long as he could.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The first keep-alives paint the mural on the attic walls with paint Spindlewight stole for them.
timeline.quote: They painted it on the attic walls with their own hands

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: One of the keep-alives sees Spindlewight maskless and flees, breaking his heart and ending his leadership.
timeline.quote: The other saw the maskless and fled into the halls, never to be seen again.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight's remaining keep-alive returns with his broken mask and leaves into the House.
timeline.quote: his keep-alive came back to the mural with his mask in hand, broken down the center

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Spindlewight dies, his bones lying somewhere in the House.
timeline.quote: Spindlewight's bones sleep somewhere in the House, unremarked and dearly remembered.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Beasties originally lived in one large pack; Spindlewight rescued two children and the beasties found their purpose protecting the House's survivors.
timeline.quote: When their leader, Spindlewight, rescued two children, the beasties found their purpose in protecting the House's survivors

citation.text: "Beast", section "Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A keep-alive sees Spindlewight's maskless face and flees; he renounces leadership and the beasties fracture into multiple packs.
timeline.quote: After one of Spindlewight's keep-alives saw his maskless face, they fled into the house, causing him to renounce his leadership

citation.text: "Beast", section "Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The first leader of the beasties, a six-legged, three-armed blue-green furred beast who wore a bone mask and found the first keep-alives.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Keep Them Alive" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Aug 2024.
